Package com.recruitment.util

Class DeepSeekClient

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.util.DeepSeekClient
public class DeepSeekClient extends Object
Lightweight client for the DeepSeek Chat API. Uses Java 11's built-in HttpClient – no extra dependencies required.

Supports both blocking (non-streaming) and SSE streaming modes. Falls back gracefully: if the API call fails the caller receives null and should fall back to the rule-based result.

    • chatStreaming

      public void chatStreaming(String systemPrompt, String userMessage, int maxTokens, Consumer<String> onToken, Runnable onDone, Consumer<String> onError)
      Stream a chat response via SSE. Each token chunk is delivered to onToken on a background thread as it arrives.

      Must NOT be called on the Swing EDT; run it in a separate thread.

      Parameters:
      systemPrompt - system message defining assistant behaviour
      userMessage - end-user prompt content
      maxTokens - maximum tokens in the completion
      onToken - called with each incremental text fragment (never null)
      onDone - called once when the stream ends successfully
      onError - called with an error message if the request fails

    • streamSkillGapAnalysis

      public void streamSkillGapAnalysis(String jobTitle, String requiredSkills, String candidateName, String candidateSkills, double matchPercent, String missingSkills, Consumer<String> onToken, Runnable onDone, Consumer<String> onError)
      Stream a skill-gap analysis. Tokens are delivered to onToken as they arrive; onDone is called when the stream completes.
      Parameters:
      jobTitle - vacancy title
      requiredSkills - comma-separated or formatted required skills for the job
      candidateName - applicant display name
      candidateSkills - applicant's skill list
      matchPercent - precomputed match percentage (0–100)
      missingSkills - skills the candidate lacks
      onToken - incremental text callback
      onDone - completion callback
      onError - error callback with a human-readable message
